name: Gemini
good_for: Great for quick answers, help inside Google apps like Gmail and Docs, and looking things up on the web.
watch_out: The free version has usage limits, and the cheapest paid plan (Google AI Plus) costs $4.99 a month.

name: Kimi
good_for: A free chatbot that handles very long documents and searches the web, with open models you can also run yourself.
watch_out: It is made by a Chinese company, so think carefully about what personal details you share.

good_for: It turns your written text into realistic spoken audio using over 600 voices in 142 languages and accents.
name: PlayAI (formerly PlayHT)
watch_out: It is priced by how much audio you make, so heavy use or voice cloning can get expensive fast.

good_for: Great for business-ready pictures that are safe to use commercially, since it is trained on licensed content.
name: Adobe Firefly
watch_out: The free plan only gives 25 credits a month, and unused credits do not roll over to the next month.

good_for: Great for making social media posts, flyers, and presentations with AI help, right inside an easy drag-and-drop design tool.
name: Canva AI (Magic Studio)
watch_out: The free plan only gives a small number of AI uses each month, and Canva prices change by country, so check the pricing page for your own price.

name: CapCut AI
good_for: A free video editor from the maker of TikTok with AI captions, background removal, and text-to-speech built right in.
watch_out: Some features and cloud storage need the paid Pro plan, which costs $19.99 a month; CapCut is best for short videos, not full movies.

name: Character AI
good_for: Great for chatting and roleplaying with fun characters you pick or create yourself - story heroes, historical figures, and helpful personas.
watch_out: The free plan has daily limits, and the characters sometimes make things up; the paid plan costs $9.99 a month.

name: ChatGPT
good_for: Great for chatting, writing, homework help, planning trips, and turning word descriptions into pictures.
watch_out: The free plan is limited and can show ads; the cheapest paid plan (Go) costs $8 a month.

name: Claude
good_for: Great for writing help, summarizing long documents, answering coding questions, and thinking ideas through carefully.
watch_out: The free plan runs out of messages fast on busy days; the Pro plan costs $20 a month when billed monthly.

good_for: An AI coding helper that works in your terminal; it can read your whole project, make changes, and run tests.
name: Claude Code
watch_out: There is no free access, and usage limits mean heavy coding days can hit the cap.
